A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CGRO research despite the revised title. All 28 pages, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–G, support comparison without material reading gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original MNIST, CIFAR10, and synthetic-data experiments in Section 6, plus empirical memorization and flatness analyses in Appendices A–B.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experiments in Section 6 and the empirical analyses in Appendices A–B, including Tables 1–2 and Figures 2–4.

M1.justification: The robust-memorization construction, two-layer convolutional network, adversarial loss, restricted perturbations, and gradient-descent procedure in Sections 4–5 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MNIST, CIFAR10, and the same synthetic patch-structured classification task. The appendix experiments retain their datasets and test scenarios.

E2.justification: No evaluated comparison method is added or removed. The new Dong et al. and Xu et al. citations discuss prior research; neither becomes an experimental baseline.

E3.justification: Table 1 changes the second MNIST model-size factor from 4 to 2, although Section 6.1 still specifies 1, 4, 8, 12, 16. This revises a reported setting and introduces an inconsistency, without establishing that experiments were rerun. Other experimental settings are retained.

E4.justification: The model-capacity and feature-learning analyses retain their questions and findings. The local memorization and global-flatness analyses in Appendices A–B, including Figures 3–4, are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The synthetic experiment's minimum, maximum, and average noise components across training examples remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Figure 1 contains different trajectories beyond converting error to accuracy: near epoch 50, v3 depicts robust-training error around 0.48, equivalent to 52% accuracy, whereas v4 depicts roughly 62% accuracy. Comparable underlying run settings are not established. Tables 1–2 retain their accuracy values apart from equivalent rounding, and Figures 2–4 are unchanged.

T1.justification: The definitions, assumptions, representation-complexity bounds, training-dynamics results, and global-flatness bounds are unchanged. The mathematical material and proofs throughout Appendices B–G also match.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the representation-complexity explanation and three-stage training-dynamics explanation of CGRO. The expanded title explicitly names these existing perspectives without changing their scope.

C2.justification: The new Section 2 paragraph explicitly interprets CGRO's high clean accuracy as involving 'no clean memorization or clean overfitting' when distinguishing prior memorization studies. The existing mechanism explanations and applicability qualifications otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 6.1 in v3 specifies training on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU; v4 removes this disclosure. This reduces reproducibility information without establishing a hardware change. Other implementation and hyperparameter details are retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Dong et al. (2021) and Xu et al. (2021), distinguishing CGRO from their memorization studies through its simultaneous emphasis on clean generalization. A short historical paragraph about adversarial examples and FGSM is removed, but its cited works remain elsewhere.

P1.justification: v4 expands the title, updates publication text and running headers, revises part of related work, and makes limited introductory and concluding edits. It also adds acknowledgements and a generic impact statement. The main section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn with an accuracy axis, different colors, background, and legend placement. Tables 1–2 replace boxed grids with sparser rules and revised labels. Some text and references reflow, while Figures 2–4 and appendix layouts remain unchanged apart from headers.

improvement.justification: v4 adds relevant memorization literature and clearer table labels, but introduces a Table 1/Section 6.1 size-factor conflict and removes the GPU disclosure. Figure 1's changed trajectories are also unexplained. With the theory, primary accuracy tables, and appendix evidence retained, these limited gains and reporting regressions do not establish a reliable net quality direction.
